title: Broncos' Jonathon Cooper now faces felony charge after domestic violence accusation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos' Jonathon Cooper now faces felony charge after domestic violence accusation
sources.description: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper, who was arrested last week and charged with a misdemeanor after his girlfriend accused him of domestic violence, is now facing a more serious felony charge.
